rejectedIntermediate.interpretation: Tracking terrain revisions alone fixed missed final terrain updates but did not close the browser image mismatch. The final candidate also performs one settled refresh after the renderer consumes the last changing-frame request.

limits: Software rendering proves this bounded Uppsala image/buffer comparison, not physical-device FPS.
Render-work traces are synthetic and use actual Three Attributes with observed backend callbacks, not GPU timings or measured driver transfers.
Real desktop WebGPU and phone WebGL2 median/p95/p99 frame times, moving-camera hitches, startup and total memory remain unmeasured.

Uppsala close motion, Puttom forest load, Veckefjarden water and phone touch/pinch/flight takeover still need physical-device acceptance at matched actual buffers/settings; check normal automatic fallback separately.
